desc:
Jump into an explosive open world! Place explosives, blow up the map, send zombies flying, and trigger massive chain reactions!

💣 Unlock brand-new, more powerful explosives for bigger blasts!
🧱 Build freely with blocks — make towers, paths, or your own huge explosion arena!
🚀 Unlock RPGs, explosive catapults and missile launchers for even more chaos!
💰 Destroy blocks and blow up zombies to earn points and buy stronger explosive gear!
🏆 Deal as much destruction as you can. See who can cause the most damage and survive the longest!

Place your explosives, light the fuse, then run — or you might be the next one to get blown away!
👍 Having fun? Don’t forget to like and favorite the game!
🔔 Join our Discord community for powerful TNT redeem codes!
